svg.title: Board after the functional requirements
svg.desc: Functional: / 1. A team sends a message to a user by push, SMS, or email / 2. A user chooses which channels to receive / 3. A team checks whether a message was delivered / Out: templates, campaigns to many users, scheduled sending
